Roadmap

ClipLoop is evolving from a promo generator into a programmable video generation platform.

PhaseStatusItems
v0 — NowliveWeekly Promo API, API keys with scopes, credits, idempotency, usage dashboard
v0.1betaSDK (@cliploop/sdk), CLI (cliploop), docs site
v0.2plannedGeneric video generation endpoint, scene specs, video job polling
v0.3plannedRemote render workers, SSE progress, priority lanes
v1.0futureWebhooks, team accounts, template marketplace, platform render presets

For the full platform vision, see docs/API_PLATFORM_ROADMAP.md.
